description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Request Context functionality, focusing on context propagation across grain calls. It verifies that ambient data set in the request context flows from caller to callee, and includes test cases for both directions, with one test currently skipped.

classes.name: RequestContextTests
classes.description: Test class for Orleans Request Context functionality, testing the flow of ambient data in distributed calls.

methods.name: RequestContextCallerToCalleeFlow
methods.description: Tests that data set in RequestContext before a grain call is accessible within the grain, demonstrating ambient context propagation.

methods.name: RequestContextCalleeToCallerFlow
methods.description: Tests that data set within a grain's RequestContext is available to the caller after the grain call, verifying bidirectional context flow. Note that this test is currently skipped.
